description: 🍪 The best Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies you’ll ever make 🤤🍪 Save this recipe ⬇️ Ingredients: • 170g unsalted butter (1 stick & 1/2) • 175g light brown sugar • 35g granulated sugar • 1 large egg + 1 egg yolk • 1 tbsp vanilla extract • 220g all-purpose flour • ¾ tsp baking soda • ¾ tsp salt • Desired amount of chocolate chips (milk/semisweet) (about 1 cup)  • Flaky sea salt (optional) Simple instructions: 1. Brown the butter and let it cool for 10 minutes. 2. Mix the butter with brown and granulated sugar  3. Mix in the egg, egg yolk & vanilla. 4. Fold in the flour, baking soda & salt just until combined ( don’t over mix ) 5. Fold in the chocolate. 6. Scoop into 3 tbsp-sized balls. 7. Chill the dough balls for at least 1-3 hrs In the fridge  8. Bake at 350°F for 12–13 minutes. 9. Let cool slightly & enjoy! 🤎🍪
